'''Marky Mark''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Thunder Bay tournament]] in March 2000 with Jawa Siesta, according to Derek Tessier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d760">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-18-thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00d760/ thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00], DeckTech (Derek "UnknownGlyph" Tessier, 18 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-18-thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00d760/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
